verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack: logo, then headline, then CTA. The hierarchy is clear and the text is legible, but it reads as a stacked square rather than a left-to-right banner, and the CTA sits fairly close to the bottom edge. In B the CTA is squeezed into an awkward two-line wrap jammed against the right edge, and a bokeh dot sits right on 'Summer Line'. B also shrinks the SOLSTICE logo until it is barely readable and leaves the left third empty, so the balance is lopsided.
